items.summary: The 2026 Startup Canada Tour will be at the Living Arts Centre on October 29, 2026 As entrepreneurs navigate rising costs, emerging technologies, and an increasingly complex business landscape, this event is your go-to source for expert talks and networking to help you adapt, grow, and scale your business. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to take your business to the next level!

items.title: Mississauga sBOOky Village
items.summary: Get ready for four days of frightfully fun fall festivities at Mississauga sBOOky Village ! Taking over Square One from October 29 to November 1, this Halloween and harvest-themed event features local vendors, delicious food, festive displays, family-friendly activities, a scavenger hunt, pumpkin carving, costume contests, and more. Soak up the seasonal atmosphere by day, then enjoy a Halloween DJ party after dark.
items.venue: Square One Shopping Centre, P6 Parking Lot

items.title: Mississauga Music Nights — Halloween Show
items.summary: Celebrate Halloween with an unforgettable evening of live music at Mississauga Music Nights — Halloween Show . This special showcase features an all-female lineup of talented GTA-based Pop, R&B, and Soul artists, highlighting both emerging and award-winning performers. Enjoy live performances from Mississauga Music Awards Fan Choice winner Maame G. , rising Latin-pop artist Jasy , genre-blending singer-songwriter Maylana , acclaimed vocalist Shanaya Z.

items.title: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox – The Future Is Vintage World Tour
items.summary: Postmodern Jukebox brings its signature vintage-inspired sound to the stage with The Future is Vintage Tour . Known for reimagining modern hits in classic jazz, swing, soul, and big band styles, the internationally acclaimed music collective delivers a high-energy live experience featuring talented singers, dancers, and musicians. Audiences can expect fresh takes on songs spanning multiple decades, from classic rock favourites to contemporary chart-toppers, movie themes, and more.

items.title: Streetsville Spooktacular
items.summary: Streetsville Spooktacular Presented by Amica Credit Mills Get ready for a spine-tingling good time! Streetsville Spooktacular is back with tricks, treats and plenty of frightfully fun Halloween activities for the whole family. Dress up in your Halloween best and stroll through the Village for trick-or-treating at participating businesses. Bring your own bag and get ready to fill it with plenty of sweet surprises.

items.title: Halloween in the Village 2026
items.summary: Halloween in the Village is back on Saturday, October 31, 2026 , bringing an afternoon of family-friendly fun to Clarkson Village. Put on your favourite costume and join us for an exciting community celebration featuring: 🎃 Bouncy Castles 🚂 Trackless Train 🎡 Games 🎨 Face Painting 🎭 Live Performances 🍬 Tricks & Treats 👻 Plus a few spooky surprises that promise to be frightfully good!

items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: River Mouth IV: The 4th Dimension
items.summary: River Mouth IV: The 4th Dimension brings the bars, beats, and energy to Mississauga for one massive night of hip-hop culture. Headlined by hometown heavyweights The Indestructible RUNXGUN , the night features explosive live performances from artists across the GTA, exclusive debuts of brand-new music recorded at Metalworks Studios, and the return of the high-stakes River Mouth Cypher , where elite MCs battle for bragging rights and a cash prize.
